text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0835 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.30 to C$1.30 a tonne higher as funds were expected to look to cover shorts, crusher demand was expected to resume and support from USDA soyoil export figures. August was seen up C$1.30 at the open, November may rise C$0.30 to C$0.80. November WCE futures crush margin rose to -4.64 Wednesday from -7.02 Tuesday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3725, flat at 82.11 yen, fell to 1.2729 marks.
FLAXSEED - Mixed. C$1.00 up in July on short covering, C$1.00 down on follow through pressure and hedges.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.50 to C$1.00 lower on overbought sentiments.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on overbought conditions.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
